questions: How many CsV3Sb5 devices did you oxidize or etch, and how many showed a field-free diode? Your ten pristine devices are counted (p. 4, Table S1); I could not find the same count for processed devices, or for Ti-doped devices beyond Devices 15 and 16.
Why were the other processed devices, if any, set aside?
Which field steps, temperatures, sweep rates and numbers of sweeps did you measure beyond the ones shown, in particular the field step in Fig. 4 and any fields between 0 and 0.1 T?

What does the second-best dataset look like? Devices 12 and 14 appear in the SI; it would help to see the pristine devices with the same number of repeated sweeps, so the baseline spread of η sits on the same footing as Fig. 3d,e.

What is the residual field at the sample at nominal 0 T in the PPMS and in the dilution refrigerator, how was it measured, and what field history (the Fig. 4 series, the 1 T field cooling of Figs. S8 and S9) preceded each zero-field dataset?

The SI labels seem to differ from the main text: Fig. S3 calls the Fig. 2 device "Device 12", and Fig. S4 and the Supplementary Text give η = 17.07%, -30.86% and -14.07% for an oxidized "Device 13", while p. 5 gives "between −30.86% and 17.07%" for Device 12 and describes Device 13 as etched. Which device is which?

For Ti-doped Devices 15 and 16, what are the thickness, Tc, critical current and transition shape after each processing step, and how many sweeps did you take per step? Did oxidation give the same multi-peak transition you show in Fig. 2b?

What dV/dI threshold defines the onset current, and how do you apply it when the transition has several peaks? Switching-current histograms for each direction would show how far the sweep-to-sweep spread of η exceeds ordinary switching statistics.
